Apply summary_fn across cells and persist into summary_assay

Source: R/fit_utils.R
dot-apply_summary_fn.Rd

Apply summary_fn across cells and persist into summary_assay

Usage

.apply_summary_fn(
  se,
  fit_dt,
  summary_fn,
  summary_assay,
  merge,
  fit_source,
  on_error
)

Arguments

se

SummarizedExperiment

fit_dt

flat data.table with "row", "column", and all fit columns

summary_fn

function(data.table) -> named list

summary_assay

assay name for summary output

merge

merge strategy

fit_source

fit_source label

on_error

error handling strategy

Value

updated SummarizedExperiment
